thread:
sara_support: FYI customer ACME reporting failures when using JSON-mode + function calling. 400 returned: "invalid structured output: expected array for 'line_items'". Escalating.
acme_integration: Paste of what we send and the error: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","json_mode":true,"function_call":{...},"input":{"order_id":"ORD-9234","line_items":[]}}'
```
Response: `{\"error\":\"invalid structured output: expected array for 'line_items' but got null\"}`
akshay_eng: Can you paste the declared function schema and a minimal repro payload (exact JSON). Also which SDK version / runtime version? Was customer using server-side serialization or our SDK?
acme_integration: Schema (trimmed):
```json
{"name":"submit_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"line_items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"}}},"required":["order_id","line_items"]}}
```
Minimal payload we sent: `{"order_id":"ORD-9234","line_items":[]}`
We double-checked — in our backend we do send an empty array. Getting null on server side. SDK used: redwood-js@2.4.0.
jordan_sre: any recent deploys to runtime around the time this started?
deploy-bot: Deployed eng-runtime@v3.7.1 to prod at 2123456820 by ci/cd pipeline (release/2026-03-15).
akshay_eng: ok. Repro steps for us: please call with header `X-Redwood-Debug: json-serialize` and paste the runtime logs (we have a log hook that prints serialized payload). Also include `X-Request-ID`.
acme_integration: repro with debug header:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Debug: json-serialize' \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","json_mode":true,"function_call":true,"input":{"order_id":"ORD-9234","line_items":[]}}'
```
Runtime debug output (excerpt):
```
[info] incoming structured payload: {"order_id":"ORD-9234","line_items":null}
[error] validation failed: path=\/line_items required array but got null
```
akshay_eng: thanks. That log shows the serializer delivered `line_items: null` downstream. My hypothesis: a recent runtime change combined with redwood-js@2.4.0's object -> structured conversion is coercing empty arrays inside optional/nullable wrappers to null when certain type hints are missing. In other words, the empty array is being lost during our JSON-mode pre-processing step.
margaret_prodeng: what's customer impact (# requests failing, since when)? Any billing or rate-limit noise?
akshay_eng: ACME says ~2% of their orders start failing since 2123456800, ~40 errors in last hour. No billing spikes observed, just validation failures leading to retries. Root cause looks like serializer edge-case introduced in eng-runtime@v3.7.1.
akshay_eng: immediate mitigations: 1) customer can send explicit non-empty placeholder (not ideal), or 2) set `json_mode: false` to bypass structured-mode serialization, or 3) upgrade to patched SDK/runtime. I'm pushing a PR to backport a fix that preserves empty arrays: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/1234 (hotfix branch v3.7.2-hotfix). Patch adds a `preserve_empty_array` flag to the internal serializer and reverts the coercion. ETA ~90m for rollout to canary.
margaret_prodeng: please post rollback plan if hotfix fails and notify CS with exact messaging.
akshay_eng: rollback plan: revert eng-runtime@v3.7.1 -> eng-runtime@v3.6.x in the canary region, then promote v3.7.0 until hotfix validated. I'll coordinate with SRE for canary.
sara_support: messaging to customer (I sent): "We're seeing a serializer edge-case in JSON-mode introduced in our recent runtime rollout. Short-term workaround: include at least one placeholder item in line_items or set json_mode=false. Engineers are deploying a hotfix (ETA ~90m). We'll notify you when fixed." :thumbsup:
acme_integration: confirmed workaround works for us (added `line_items:[{}]` yields success). Thanks for quick turnaround.
akshay_eng: canary deployed v3.7.2-hotfix to eu-west at 2123456900, monitoring. Will post logs once stable.
deploy-bot: Deployed eng-runtime@v3.7.2-hotfix to eu-west canary at 2123456900.
akshay_eng: canary looks good — preserved empty arrays in debug trace, no regressions in other tests. Rolling to global prod over next 30m.
sara_support: closing escalation for now, ticket #INC-8842 created for postmortem & customer follow-up. Will ping when GA rollout done.
acme_integration: appreciate it, keep us posted.
akshay_eng: follow-up PR linked and changelog entry created. Will add a unit test to prevent empty-array coercion regressions.
